topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't shake this sense of the past looping round, taunting me. It's Mr. Thompson, of all people, in the school newsletter, smiling back at me from the faded photocopy in my trembling hands. It's him, and now him for Jamie too. The world's a cruel, tight knot, drawing us closer to our shadows. How many years have I tried to outrun that chalk-stained voice, the way he lingered after class, the hollow echo of those corridor talks. And now Jamie, my Jamie, stepping into that net, that labyrinth. I have to find a way, some way, to pull them both free. The walls are closing in, the clock ticks louder. I can hardly breathe, thinking of it.
